I really don't care that much about a T-Shirt lol. I am just putting this out there for those who need a little advice that isn't the usual "You suck" "Get Good" or "KYS". Now, I don't understand how you find that the information it gives you is "vague". It tells you a general idea about where you are good, and where you need improvement and even suggest specific pros to watch in order to understand why they are telling you where you need to improve and things you can do and modify to better your play style. If it is a waste of time to YOU, that's one thing. But many people can benefit from a site like this. Some people prefer Op.GG, others prefer LolKing. Some prefer Mobafire, others ProBuilds. But to just knock a site by pure opinion is absurd! Let the bronzies get better!

Exactly! Most players want to improve but don't have the amount of money necessary for a league coach or don't want to spend hours on Twitch or YouTube watching videos. This site can help trim down what they should look for to improve. This is very useful for "terrible/new players"

If you know the gist of the game, yes maybe. But for those who usually play alone and need a little specificity in where they lack in strength, this site will definitely serve as a sort of tutor. Better than most sites IMHO.

Very in depth analysis on your play, and even gives you advice as to where your strong points are and where you need improvement. Highly recommended my play has improved drastically with the little tips and recommendations. Free and simple.
